name: Southeast Faerûn
title: Southeast Faerûn: The Shining Lands
description: Southeast Faerûn is a region of exceptional beauty and wealth, including the fertile lands around the Vilhon Reach and the vast plains that lead toward the Great Rift.
wiki: This region is known for its sophisticated city-states and rich agricultural output. The Vilhon Reach is a major center of civilization, while the interior plains are home to nomadic tribes and hidden wonders. The proximity to the Sea of Fallen Stars ensures a steady flow of trade and cultural exchange.
